scope: Exact definite order, certified integral dyadic splitting, and one norm-one unit transporting adjacent edges while fixing the base vertex.

sources.title: Magma Handbook, Hilbert Symbols and Embeddings
sources.use: Propose a local integral splitting for a p-maximal order in an algebra split at p. Ramification of F_p over Q_2 is allowed. Independent Hensel and lattice checks certify the final embedding rather than trusting finite-precision equalities.

sources.title: Marc Masdeu and Eloi Torrents, Fundamental domains for quaternionic S-arithmetic groups over totally real fields
sources.use: Norm-one S-arithmetic group, integral splitting, column-lattice tree action and exact arithmetic equivalence witnesses. No execution or performance claim for the full fundamental-domain algorithm.

local_sources.use: The actual level-one definite HMF construction chooses (-1,-1)_F and a maximal order. Read only.
Existing pMatrixRing usage and ideal/transport interface inspected. No new ideal-class enumeration requested.
Interface scope: the level-one SplittingMap is not used as the desired dyadic splitting. Stabilizer-order output is not a matrix or a transporter.
D99 field, seed, definite order construction and saved 58-class Brandt data. No claim to identify an exported ideal-class ordering from the local order alone.
Prior feasibility gate and conditional moment-to-jet evaluator; all 606 bound sources preserved.

project_deductions: Exact closure of the 32-dimensional integer lattice and trace discriminant 2^124 certify the order.
The rational Hensel residual has valuation 188 and derivative valuation 8, specifying an exact root with error valuation 180.
Quaternion identities, order-image errors of at least 176, and residue rank four prove the integral local splitting.
The exact norm-one unit (1-i-j-k)/2 reduces to [1,1;1,0] and induces neighbor permutation [2,0,1].
An integral lattice transition with determinant one proves the edge transport; wrong-root and wrong-target controls are rejected.
excluded_inferences: No full arithmetic group or Shimura normalizer quotient has been constructed.
No full tree fundamental domain, cross-vertex side-pairing, new class census or Hecke bank.
No invariant harmonic cocycle, actual moments, dyadic CM/frame matching or Shimura tangent/jet.
No candidate identification or target field polynomial.
